lineage.distinction: This MVE is an event-style short-horizon extreme-premium compression trade. It does not retest static carry harvesting or long-horizon basis carry.

economic_mechanism: When Binance USD-M perpetual premium is unusually positive versus its own recent history, arbitrageurs can buy spot and short the perpetual while funding pressure makes the long-perp side expensive. The paired position should benefit if the perp underperforms spot as the premium compresses.

signal.standardization: z = (current_premium - mean(prior 2016 premium closes)) / sample_std(prior 2016 premium closes)
signal.sign_rule: Signal only when current premium > 0 and z >= 3.0

execution.entry: Next synchronized 5-minute bar open after the completed signal bar on both spot and perpetual
execution.exit: Synchronized open exactly 12 bars / 60 minutes after entry
execution.funding_crossing_rule: Exclude any episode whose entry-to-exit interval includes a scheduled 00:00, 08:00 or 16:00 UTC funding timestamp, including exact entry/exit timestamps. Funding cashflow is therefore set to zero rather than estimated.
execution.cost_rationale: Conservative fixed research cost stress for four fills across spot and perpetual. It is deliberately not lower than the closed prior cash-and-carry lineage and is not claimed to be exact account-specific historical fees.

no_rescue_rule: After the canonical Discovery opens outcomes, do not change the 7-day window, z=3 threshold, positive-premium-only side, 5m timeframe, 60m hold, funding-crossing exclusion, assets, costs, source years or gates under this MVE ID.

data_integrity.duplicate_timestamp_rule: Exact duplicate rows may deduplicate by timestamp only if OHLC/premium values are identical; conflicting duplicate timestamps are DATA_FAILURE.
data_integrity.synchronized_execution_rule: Every selected signal must have both spot and perpetual entry/exit bars. Any selected signal with unresolved execution bars is an integrity failure, not silently dropped.
